generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

If the TIA/TAA wishes to verify any or all original document uploaded by the bidder in KPP Portal, Mandatorily the Tenderer produce required relevant original Documents for verification. If the any bidder fails to produce originals documents, the Tender will be rejected

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or ongoing under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application

The contractor has to submit MDP compulsorily with respect of utilization of Royalty Payable Materials to the extent of 100%, failing the royalty charges, additional payment on royalty & penalties if any will be recovered from the contractor bills as per the prevailing Government orders

The rates quoted by the contractor must be exclusive GST but inclusive of all other taxes & Cesses. The contractor is also responsible to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor
Applicable GST will be paid separately at the prevailing rates & GST TDS will be deducted as per the prevailing Government Orders
Increase in GST if any shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL before using

The work includes all lead and lift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per Indian road congress and all relevant Indian codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height. No extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts

Successful Bidder should submit the Construction program along with PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement & should adhere to the accepted program submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work
Sub leasing/sub contracting in any form are prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Sub Leasing /subcontracting are liable for rejection
Typographical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

If CNNL wishes to engage third party/Project Management consultants for quality control assessment, apart from the CNNL quality control and field tests, the contractor should co-Operate with both Quality control authorities and the third party/Project Management consultants
Idle charges for men & machineries for non-progress period delayed due to any reasons will not be paid

With respect to quality control and field tests aspects of works, Guidelines issued by Nigama vide circular no. CNNL/Tech-5/Quality Control/2023-24, date:15.02.2024 will be followed. It is the responsibility of the contractor to prepare Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) and obtain the approval from competent authority before executing the work.

Useful rubble and stone chips obtained from excavation shall be issued to the contractor for use on works at the rates specified for these materials in the Schedule of Rates current at the time of issue
The work should be executed as per the guidelines of respective IS/IRC or other relevant codes being in force & as per the directions of Engineer in charge
All other conditions as per IFT & Bid document
